[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 600
- Description: Transfer GAS hardening + ledger dedup + Scoring Hash Key column P + Governor season PDF/perm audit
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/544
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/545
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/546
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/547
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/548
  
  Details:
  Thread 34264 — two days (2026-09-21 → 2026-09-22) of debugging, repairing and verifying the scored-contributions transfer pipeline, ledger integrity, and the governor season comms.
  
  WHAT SHIPPED
  1. Diagnosed why the Scored Chatlogs → Main Ledger transfer GAS kept duplicating rows: duplicate function declarations in a legacy file shadowing Code.js, a per-row full-sheet read timing out, an out-of-list status write aborting the whole run, and a dead duplicate guard.
  2. PR #544 — repair transfer web app: drop duplicate fns, robust doGet, canonical Ledger write.
  3. PR #545 — fail closed on RESOLVE FAILED rows (guard was dead).
  4. PR #546 — fix run abort: out-of-list state write to strictly-validated col F.
  5. PR #547 — enforce transfer duplicate guard (txn-ID first; was dead code).
  6. PR #548 — persist Scoring Hash Key in ledger column P (durable dedup key) + serialize transfers with a script lock; SCHEMA.md updated. Merged to tokenomics main (aaf8ef0).
  7. Ledger deduplication executed and verified: 86 + 358 redundant rows removed across two passes (~40,600 TDG), totals reconciled to E1; Class-A split groups preserved.
  8. Backfilled ledger column P ("Scoring Hash Key") on 3,624 rows, joined to origin column K. GAS deployed to production (version 16) onto the live deployment; smoke-tested (?ping=1 → ok); ledger verified untouched.
  9. Regenerated the Governors of the September–December 2026 Season PDF from the post-dedup live ledger (top-10: Gary Teh 87,697 / Elizabeth Wong 7,971 / Jacob Nelan 6,442 / Kirsten Ritschel 6,132 / Milena 3,000 / AGL15 2,292 / Paloma 1,642 / June Jo 1,100 / Ken Nim 860 / Philip Lee 800).
  10. Audited governor sheet permissions: found the sync ran pre-dedup, so 4 current governors lack editor access (blank emails) and ex-governor Val Lapidus still holds a seat. Awaiting emails + explicit go before any permission change.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 1000.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
